title: The girl Franklin Clinton lost in GTA 5
subject: franklin
description:
Did Franklin deserve a second chance with Tanisha? 👇

The love story most GTA 5 players walked past. Spoilers for Grand Theft Auto V and GTA Online: The Contract.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: His first love walked away before he ever got rich.
Tanisha Jackson grew up beside Franklin Clinton in Strawberry, and she was done with the gang life Lamar kept pulling him into.
Then Michael and Trevor's heists bought Franklin a house in Vinewood Hills.
Rockstar returned to him in The Contract, a December 2021 GTA Online update.
Eight years older, Franklin runs his own agency, and the woman wearing his ring is Tanisha.
She left the kid from Forum Drive, then married the man he became.
